name: Hezrul Bloodmark

narrative.details:
Hezrul Bloodmark is the leader of the Kolkar centaurs in the Barrens.  He is fierce, brutal and cunning.  Defeating him would disrupt and fracture the Kolkars, greatly reducing their threat to us.

So kill him.  As with Barak and Verog, bring me Hezrul's Head.

He leads his people from the Lushwater Oasis, to the south.
narrative.objectives: Bring Hezrul's Head to Regthar Deathgate, west of the Crossroads.
narrative.offerRewardText: I commend you, adventurer. These centaur are undisciplined and cannot focus their rage as the orcs can, but they are fierce nonetheless. In defeating them, your valor is proven.
